QuestInfo.name: The Phantom Signal
QuestInfo.0: Ask Cygnus how you can meet Phantom.
QuestInfo.1: Cygnus isn't sure, but she suggests putting up a large sign in a high place to get Phantom's attention. \r\nGo to the Small Bridge in Ereve with the sign Cygnus gave you.
QuestInfo.2: You put up the sign and wonder why Cygnus had it so handy.
QuestInfo.demandSummary: Place the sign on the Small Bridge, east of Ereve
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:
#Wbasic#
#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 150,000
Can proceed to A Bigger Phantom Signal

0.0: I will dispatch some knights to Maple Island to help in whatever way they can. Unfortunately, I have no way of contacting Phantom, either. He comes and goes as he pleases.
0.1: We do see him fly past Ereve in his airship on occasion. We are rather high up, after all.
0.2: I have an idea, but you have to promise not to laugh. Why don't you make a sign and place it in the highest part of Ereve? Perhaps Phantom will see it.

yes.0: Here, take this. Write your message as big as you can, then place the sign somewhere high.
yes.1: There's a #bSmall Bridge#k to the right. There's not much out there, so a sign would really stand out.

no.0: That's my only idea. I'm sorry.

yes.0: (Hey... Why did the Empress of Ereve have such a large piece of poster board handy, anyway? And why did it already say 'PHANTOM' in glitter letters at the top?)

npc.0: There's a #bSmall Bridge#k to the right. There's not much out there, so a sign would really stand out. If you DO meet Phantom, tell... Nevermind.
